$comment: What deploy/configure.mjs generates and deploy/release.mjs deploys. `workers` is in dependency order: callees before callers. Promotion follows this order; rollback goes the other way.

shared_vars.$comment: Deployment-wide values every Worker must agree on. Applied to each Worker whose own config declares the var; a differing component value is overridden and reported.

script_aliases.$comment: Names components use today for the write-path script. All of them are viz-ingest.

workers.name: viz-ruler
workers.reason: Not wired to real engines: its EVALUATOR and SINK service bindings do not exist yet (ruler/wrangler.jsonc), so every rule would report health: err.

workers.name: viz-publisher
workers.reason: Nothing triggers it: publisher/README.md lists no queue consumer, no cron handler and no nudge from the ledger; the Worker entry only exports the class.

workers.name: viz-mcp
workers.reason: Binds viz-ruler (service RULER), which is not deployed, and its query tools would reach rules that cannot evaluate; mcp/wrangler.jsonc says it was never deployed and mcp has no README yet.
